items.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Posted Its Highest Ever North America Sales Weekend
items.summary: Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) reports its Unicorn Frappuccino promotion delivered the highest-ever North America sales weekend for the company. The limited-time drink tapped into social media and pop culture trends, driving heavy store traffic and strong demand for the colorful beverage. Management links the weekend performance to a focus on fresh menu ideas that connect with current cultural moments.
